# API reference

<!-- Generated by `aios docs reference`. Do not edit: change the code it is made from. -->

Every route of the AIOS API. Send a credential as `Authorization: Bearer <key or token>`;
a local `aios dev` server needs none. What each caller may do is decided by their roles
(see the user guide). The full OpenAPI document is served at `/openapi.json`.

## agents

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/agents` | Every agent, its version, what it may do, whether it is stopped, and its recent work. |

## apply

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/v1/apply` | Offer manifests as a version. ``consent=all`` agrees to all it asks for, in one step. |

## approvals

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/approvals` | Approvals |
| `GET` | `/v1/approvals/{approval_id}` | Approval |
| `POST` | `/v1/approvals/{approval_id}/approve` | Approve |
| `POST` | `/v1/approvals/{approval_id}/deny` | Deny |

## apps

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/apps` | Apps |
| `GET` | `/v1/apps/{app}` | What the App is made of: its agents, the work people do, its workflows and steps. |
| `GET` | `/v1/apps/{app}/evaluations/online` | Production runs graded as they finished (FR-OBS-07 online evaluation). |
| `POST` | `/v1/apps/{app}/experiments` | Run an evaluation suite against the App; a worker runs it (FR-OBS-07). |
| `GET` | `/v1/apps/{app}/experiments` | The App's experiments, newest first. |
| `GET` | `/v1/apps/{app}/experiments/{experiment}` | An experiment: each case, its grades, its score, and whether it passes its gate. |
| `GET` | `/v1/apps/{app}/experiments/{experiment}/compare/{other}` | Two experiments case by case: one suite on two versions of the App. |
| `POST` | `/v1/apps/{app}/experiments/{experiment}/grades` | A person's grade for a case that asked for one. |
| `GET` | `/v1/apps/{app}/feedback` | Feedback |
| `GET` | `/v1/apps/{app}/feedback/cases` | Evaluation cases from corrections, to add to an Evaluation's ``spec.cases``. |
| `PUT` | `/v1/apps/{app}/knowledge` | Knowledge |
| `POST` | `/v1/apps/{app}/knowledge/url` | Knowledge Url |
| `GET` | `/v1/apps/{app}/policies` | An App's policies as written and as Cedar runs them (FR-UI-06). |
| `POST` | `/v1/apps/{app}/policies/simulate` | Would this be allowed now? Nothing happens, and nothing is recorded. |
| `POST` | `/v1/apps/{app}/runs` | Start Run |
| `GET` | `/v1/apps/{app}/runs` | List Runs |
| `GET` | `/v1/apps/{app}/runs/{run_id}` | Get Run |
| `POST` | `/v1/apps/{app}/runs/{run_id}/cancel` | Cancel Run |
| `GET` | `/v1/apps/{app}/runs/{run_id}/compare/{other}` | Two runs side by side, step by step: usually a run and its replay or fork. |
| `GET` | `/v1/apps/{app}/runs/{run_id}/events` | Run Events |
| `POST` | `/v1/apps/{app}/runs/{run_id}/feedback` | Rate or correct what a run, or one of its steps, did (FR-HUM-09). |
| `POST` | `/v1/apps/{app}/runs/{run_id}/fork` | Start again from a step, with changes, and side effects held back (FR-OBS-04). |
| `POST` | `/v1/apps/{app}/runs/{run_id}/pause` | Pause Run |
| `POST` | `/v1/apps/{app}/runs/{run_id}/replay` | Run it again with every model and tool call answered from its record (FR-OBS-04). |
| `POST` | `/v1/apps/{app}/runs/{run_id}/resume` | Resume Run |
| `POST` | `/v1/apps/{app}/runs/{run_id}/retry` | Start again from a step for real: side effects happen again (FR-WF-11). |
| `POST` | `/v1/apps/{app}/runs/{run_id}/signal` | Signal Run |
| `GET` | `/v1/apps/{app}/runs/{run_id}/trace` | The run as a graph of its steps, with what each did (FR-OBS-03). |

## audit

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/audit` | Audit Entries |
| `GET` | `/v1/audit/verify` | Audit Verify |

## costs

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/costs` | A month's spending by App, agent, model and person, and its budgets (FR-OBS-06). |

## dlq

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/dlq` | Dead Letters |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/dlq/{letter}` | Discard |
| `POST` | `/v1/dlq/{letter}/redrive` | Redrive |

## events

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/events` | Events as they were stored, from ``after``; or with ``newest``, the latest first. |

## groups

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/groups` | The tenant's groups and their members, which approvals name as ``group:<name>``. |
| `PUT` | `/v1/groups/{group}` | Set who is in a group. Members are principals of the caller's tenant. |

## hooks

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/v1/hooks/{tenant}/{app}/{name}` | An outside system starts a run. Its signature stands in for a credential. |

## installations

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/installations` | Installations |
| `POST` | `/v1/installations` | Offer a version. It waits for consent unless it asks for nothing new. |
| `GET` | `/v1/installations/{app}` | Installation |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/installations/{app}` | ``data`` has no default: what becomes of it is a decision somebody has to make. |
| `PUT` | `/v1/installations/{app}/config` | Configure |
| `POST` | `/v1/installations/{app}/consent` | Consent To |
| `GET` | `/v1/installations/{app}/export` | Everything an App has: its events, then its memory, as one JSON object a line. |
| `POST` | `/v1/installations/{app}/refuse` | Refuse |
| `POST` | `/v1/installations/{app}/rollback` | Rollback |
| `GET` | `/v1/installations/{app}/versions` | Every version this tenant has had, newest first, and what each asks for. |

## keys

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/keys` | Keys |
| `POST` | `/v1/keys` | Create Key |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/keys/{key_id}` | Revoke Key |

## me

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/me` | Me |
| `GET` | `/v1/me/contact` | Where you are told about approvals for you (FR-HUM-07). |
| `PUT` | `/v1/me/contact` | Set your own: nobody can set it for you, so nobody can send your links elsewhere. |

## memory

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/v1/memory/forget` | Memory Forget |
| `POST` | `/v1/memory/search` | Memory Search |
| `GET` | `/v1/memory/{item_id}` | Memory Item |
| `PUT` | `/v1/memory/{item_id}` | Correct an item. It becomes a new version, and the change is audited (FR-UI-07). |

## schemas

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/schemas` | Every event type and manifest kind, and where its JSON Schema is (FR-EVT-10). |
| `GET` | `/v1/schemas/envelope` | Schema Of Envelope |
| `GET` | `/v1/schemas/events/{event_type}` | Schema Of Event |
| `GET` | `/v1/schemas/manifests/{kind}` | Schema Of Manifest |

## service

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/healthz` | Health |
| `GET` | `/metrics` | Prometheus |
| `POST` | `/openai/v1/chat/completions` | A chat completion: a run of the App named as the model, and its answer. |

|---|---|---|

| `POST` | `/v1/suspensions` | Suspend |

## tasks

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/tasks` | Open work assigned to people that you can do (FR-HUM-08). ``everyone`` is for operators: all of the tenant's. |
| `GET` | `/v1/tasks/{task_id}` | Task |
| `POST` | `/v1/tasks/{task_id}/complete` | Do the work: the output goes back to the run as the task's result. |
